Wintermoor Commander/attacking-grants-in: Whenever Wintermoor Commander attacks, another target Knight you control gains indestructible until end of turn: the attack trigger never fires -- no target ask and no ability lands (the harness's activate step finds only Pass/Concede after the attack). Observed: the Lightning Bolt after combat destroys the 2/2 Black Knight instead of leaving 3 damage marked (CR 603.2, 702.12b). The CDA toughness half is correct and pinned by the passing sibling scenario.
Static Orb/more-than-two-tapped-only-two: 'As long as Static Orb is untapped, players can't untap more than two permanents during their untap steps' is not enforced (CR 611.3c static): all three tapped Talismans untapped at the next untap step while the Orb was untapped. This is the conditional-static family's untap-step walk (rules/turn.go; Winter Orb, Kismet, Frozen Aether share it), so a fix there covers the class. The sibling scenario 'fewer-than-two-tapped-untap-freely' passes, pinning the normal untap.
Torpor Orb/enters-triggers-suppressed: Torpor Orb's printed static 'creatures entering don't cause abilities to trigger' is not enforced (CR 603.3b / 614.1c). With the Orb on the battlefield, Aether Adept's enters ability still triggers and returns the Adept's own Grizzly Bears to hand. Root cause: the Forge script encodes it as 'S:Mode$ DisableTriggers | ValidCause$ Creature | ValidMode$ ChangesZone,ChangesZoneAll | Destination$ Battlefield', and no engine code reads the DisableTriggers static mode (effects/misc.go effEffect registers only CantTarget/CantRegenerate/cost modes/BecomeMonarch). 7 corpus scripts carry Mode$ DisableTriggers. The control scenario without the Orb passes, and the sibling 'opponents-creature-triggers-also-suppressed' shows it is not even controller-limited.
Torpor Orb/opponents-creature-triggers-a: Same root as 'enters-triggers-suppressed': DisableTriggers is unread, so an opponent's enters ability is not suppressed either. The opponent casts Aether Adept with Torpor Orb (p0's) on the battlefield and its enters ability still triggers, returning the opponent's own Savannah Lions to hand. CR 603.3b: the static is global, not controller-limited.
